short_summary: Convertible note purchase agreement for HealthRate, Inc. raising up to $1,000,000.
long_summary: Agreement dated August 30, 2024, between HealthRate, Inc. and First Trust Capital Partners, LLC for the purchase of convertible notes totaling $1,000,000 in tranches, with proceeds used for general corporate purposes. The company is a Nevada corporation with headquarters in Hudson, WI.

use_of_funds.answer: Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

evidence.quote: the Company will use the proceeds of the Notes for general corporate purposes.

funding_milestones.value: Convertible note raise of up to $1,000,000 with tranches: $500,000 at closing, $250,000 by March 1, 2025, and $250,000 by September 1, 2025.
funding_milestones.answer: The company is raising up to $1,000,000 through convertible notes, with proceeds for general corporate purposes and tranches as specified.

evidence.quote: The maximum aggregate principal amount of all Notes issued hereunder shall not exceed $1,000,000
the Company will use the proceeds of the Notes for general corporate purposes.

Principal Amount of Notes: $1,000,000 to be tranched as follows – Note 1: $500,000 (to be sold at the Closing); Note 2: $250,000 (to be sold at an Additional Closing on a date mutually agreed upon by FTCP and the Company, but if requested by the Company no later than March 1, 2025); Note 3: $250,000 (to be sold at an Additional Closing on a date mutually agreed upon by FTCP and the Company, but if requested by the Company no later than September 1, 2025).

incorporation_documents.value: The Company is a corporation duly organized, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the State of Nevada.
incorporation_documents.answer: Company is incorporated in Nevada and in good standing.

evidence.quote: The Company is a corporation duly organized, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the State of Nevada

risk_disclosures.answer: There are no pending claims, actions, suits, proceedings, etc., that would have a material adverse effect.

evidence.quote: There is no claim, action, suit, proceeding, arbitration, complaint, charge or investigation pending or to the Company's knowledge, currently threatened ... that would reasonably be expected to have, either individually or in the aggregate, a material adverse effect on the business of the Company.
